correctness.rationale: All quantifiers and edge-density normalizations checked. Exact tilting preserves every conditional edge-count fibre; a uniform characteristic-function smoothing estimate gives the centered lattice local CLT at variance order n^3. Hoeffding concentration transfers through an event of polynomial probability, and a priority coupling changes only O(n^(3/2)) expected edges. Fixed homomorphism-density concentration and the rate likelihood ratio finish the argument. The standalone 565 finite checks are corroborative and do not establish infinite limits.
